item.title: Scientists used AI to analyse 116,000 birdsongs, identify eight common motifs
item.description: Scientists have identified eight common sound patterns that form the basis of birdsong after analysing more than 116,000 recordings from 3,160 songbird species worldwide. The study found that birds living in different habitats sing differently because forests, open landscapes and the way sound travels influence which songs work best, alongside evolution.

item.title: Quote of the day by Hulk Hogan: "If I have a problem with someone I talk about them. I don't…" - a lesson on respect, accountability and keeping personal conflicts where they belong
item.description: Disagreements should remain focused on the individuals involved in the conflict. Hulk Hogan's quote emphasizes not involving children in adult disputes. Containing arguments to the original issue prevents unnecessary harm and wider complications. Direct communication and taking responsibility build trust and aid resolution. This principle applies broadly, urging focus on behavior and ideas, not personal attacks.

item.title: Study finds Japanese horseshoe bats match each other's frequency to reduce noise in colonies
item.description: A new study has found that greater Japanese horseshoe bats adjust their echolocation calls to match the frequencies used by others in their colony instead of avoiding them. Researchers say this shared frequency creates a clearer listening range, helping bats detect prey more effectively despite many overlapping calls from nearby colony members.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Zebra mussels spread across all Great Lakes within a decade of arriving in 1988
item.description: Zebra mussels, an aquatic invader from Eurasia, continue their continental spread after arriving in North America. These tiny shellfish are now infesting Lake Meredith in Texas, raising new concerns. Officials confirmed a reproducing population, marking the lake as a potential stepping stone. The mussels damage ecosystems and infrastructure by clinging to hard surfaces and multiplying rapidly. Preventative measures like cleaning boats remain crucial to slowing their ongoing invasion.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Planted in 1937, this tree now unleashes 8.9M seeds threatening rainforests
item.description: An ornamental tree planted in Tahiti in 1937 now poses a serious biosecurity threat. This invasive miconia species aggressively invades forests and smothers native vegetation. A single mature tree can produce millions of seeds, rapidly spreading across landscapes. Queensland's World Heritage rainforests face irreversible ecological damage from this plant. Early detection and eradication efforts are crucial to protect these precious ecosystems.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: A proposed 330-megawatt AI data centre in California promised not to use Colorado River water. Now it wants 260 million gallons a year
item.description: Deemed as the largest AI data centre in the state, the 330-megawatt unit earlier promised to not use water from Colorado River. But now, the developer behind the project is suing for access to the river water which is already a threatened source of freshwater for 40 million people and the centre of countless disputes over water use in West.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: How four Moose released in 1904 ended up reshaping Newfoundland's forests forever
item.description: A century after just four moose were released in Newfoundland to attract hunters, the introduced animals transformed the island's forests and wildlife management. Their population grew to nearly 200,000 before habitat damage triggered declines. A new management plan explains how science is now helping keep moose numbers in balance with forests, public safety and long-term ecosystem health.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Google co-founder Sergey Brin turned his $450 million superyacht into a floating headquarters with an entire deck dedicated to work
item.description: Google co-founder Sergey Brin's superyacht Dragonfly features a dedicated business deck. This vessel combines luxury with functionality, reflecting his entrepreneurial approach. The yacht includes a private office and helicopter hangar for global business management. Brin's increased involvement in AI development mirrors this work-centric design. Dragonfly reimagines the superyacht as a mobile and productive workspace.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: In the 1980s, Scotland planted commercial trees across parts of a 9,000-year-old peatland
item.description: The ancient peatlands of Scotland are undergoing a significant restoration, which addresses the detrimental effects caused by tree planting. Conservationists are diligently working to eliminate commercial trees, aiming to enhance wildlife habitats and maintain stored carbon levels. This notable effort is primarily focused on the Flow Country, a treasure trove of wetlands recognized as a World Heritage Site for its global ecological importance.

item.title: Canva's billionaire founders donated $150 million directly to residents of Malawi; aided 90% rise above extreme poverty
item.description: Canva billionaires Melanie Perkins and Cliff Obrecht have made a move challenging conventional aid by putting cash directly into the hands of an East African country's poorest households. The cofounders of the Australian design software maker are investing a whopping $150 million into a cash transfer program in Malawi. Since launching the initiative in 2021 through the Canva Foundation and nonprofit GiveDirectly, the couple has expanded what began as a $10 million pilot into the largest unconditional cash transfer program ever attempted in a low-income country.

item.title: Two killed after small plane crashes into house in Germany
item.description: A light aircraft crashed into a house roof in Ganderkesee, Germany. Two men, aged sixty-five and seventy-seven, were killed in the accident. Authorities conducted a complex recovery operation to remove the embedded wreckage. Residents of the affected home were evacuated during the emergency response. German officials have initiated an investigation into the cause of the crash.
